Order No.06 Dated-10.04.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Chirkunda P.S. Case No. 167 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A, 323 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of D.P. Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. As per FIR, allegation is that the marriage of informant was solemnized with the petitioner in the year 2018 and at the time of marriage Rs.5.51 lakhs cash and other household articles was presented and also out of their wedlock, a female child was born.
After marriage, petitioner started demanding additional dowry from the informant in the shape of 100 grams gold.
Due to non-fulfillment of the aforesaid demand, she was subjected to torture mentally and physically.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case due to matrimonial dispute between the parties.
All the allegations levelled against the petitioner are entirely false and fabricated and general and omnibus in nature.
Petitioner has complied with the notice in compliance of notice under section 41A of Cr.PC and he further undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

5. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State assisted by learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that there is direct and specific allegation against the petitioner of assaulting the informant due to non-fulfillment of the additional demand of dowry and informant has one female child and petitioner does not want to keep her with full honour and dignity.
Hence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Dhanbad in connection with Chirkunda P.S. Case No. 167 of 2022 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
